  ensures ((not (x > hi)) or (result == hi))
  ensures ((not ((x >= lo) and (x <= hi))) or (result == x))

  example (clamp(7, 7, 7) == 7)
  example (clamp(-8, -5, -2) == -5)
  example (clamp(-1, -5, -2) == -2)
{

}

fn index_of(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires contains(xs, x)
  ensures (((result >= 0) and (result < len(xs))) and (xs[result] == x))
  ensures forall i in 0..result: (xs[i] != x)
  effects pure
  example (index_of([4, 7, 9], 7) == 1)
  example (index_of([3, 3, 3], 3) == 0)
  example (index_of([1, 2, 3, 2], 2) == 1)
  example (index_of([5], 5) == 0)
{
  match xs { [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then 0 else (1 + index_of(t, x)) [] => 0 }
}

fn scan(xs: List[Int], prev: Int, current_run: Int, max_run: Int) -> Int
  requires ((current_run >= 1) and (max_run >= 1))
  ensures (result >= max_run)
  effects pure
  example (scan([], 1, 1, 1) == 1)
  example (scan([2], 1, 1, 1) == 1)
  example (scan([1, 2], 1, 1, 1) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => if (current_run >= max_run) then current_run else max_run [h, ..t] => if (h == prev) then scan(t, h, (current_run + 1), if ((current_run + 1) >= max_run) then (current_run + 1) else max_run) else scan(t, h, 1, if (current_run >= max_run) then current_run else max_run) }
}

fn longest_run(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) > 0)
  ensures ((result >= 1) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures exists i in 0..len(xs): (((i + result) <= len(xs)) and (forall j in 0..result: (xs[(i + j)] == xs[i])))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): ((((i + result) + 1) > len(xs)) or (exists j in 0..(result + 1): (xs[(i + j)] != xs[i])))
  effects pure
  example (longest_run([1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3]) == 3)
  example (longest_run([7]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([1, 2, 3]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([2, 2, 2, 2]) == 4)
  example (longest_run([1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1]) == 3)
  example (longest_run([5, 5, 6, 6]) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => scan(t, h, 1, 1) }
}

fn sub_sum(xs: List[Int], a: Int, b: Int) -> Int

  ensures ((a != b) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((((b - a) != 1) or (a < 0)) or (result == xs[a]))
  effects pure
  example (sub_sum([1, 2, 3], 0, 2) == 3)
  example (sub_sum([1, -2, 3], 1, 3) == 1)
  example (sub_sum([1], 0, 0) == 0)
  example (sub_sum([5, 6, 7], 1, 2) == 6)

fn max_subarray(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires exists x in xs: (x > 0)

  example (max_subarray([2, 2, -5, 1]) == 4)
  example (max_subarray([-3, 5, -1]) == 5)
{
  match xs { [h, ..t] => max_subarray_helper(xs, t, h, h) _ => -1 }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((not result) or ((len(xs) == 0) == (r == None)))

fn has(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, v))
  effects pure
  example (has([3, 9, 1], 9) == true)
  example (has([3, 9, 1], 4) == false)
  example (has([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == v) or has(t, v)) }
}

fn greater_count(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((result == 0) or (exists x in xs: (x > v)))
  ensures ((result > 0) or (forall x in xs: (x <= v)))
  effects pure
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 3) == 1)
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 9) == 0)
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 1) == 2)
  example (greater_count([], 5) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h > v) then (1 + greater_count(t, v)) else greater_count(t, v) }
}

fn is_second(xs: List[Int], r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((r != None) or (result == (len(xs) < 2)))
  effects pure
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(3)) == true)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(9)) == false)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(1)) == false)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(7)) == false)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], None) == false)
  example (is_second([4], None) == true)
  example (is_second([4], Some(4)) == false)
  example (is_second([], None) == true)
{
  match r { None => match xs { [] => true [_, ..t] => match t { [] => true _ => false } } Some(v) => (has(xs, v) and (greater_count(xs, v) == 1)) }
}

fn find_in_list(current: List[Int], original: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires distinct(original)
  ensures is_second(original, result)
  effects pure
  example (find_in_list([3, 9, 1], [3, 9, 1]) == Some(3))
  example (find_in_list([4], [4]) == None)
  example (find_in_list([], []) == None)
  example (find_in_list([5, 2], [5, 2]) == Some(2))
  example (find_in_list([1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 2, 3, 4]) == Some(3))
{
  match current { [] => None [x, ..t] => if (greater_count(original, x) == 1) then Some(x) else find_in_list(t, original) }
}

fn second_largest(xs: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures is_second(xs, result)
  effects pure
  example (second_largest([3, 9, 1]) == Some(3))
  example (second_largest([4]) == None)
  example (second_largest([]) == None)
  example (second_largest([5, 2]) == Some(2))
  example (second_largest([1, 2, 3, 4]) == Some(3))
{
  find_in_list(xs, xs)
}

fn zip_sum(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (xs[i] + ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (zip_sum([1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]) == [11, 22, 33])
  example (zip_sum([], []) == [])
  example (zip_sum([5], [-5]) == [0])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [h2, ..t2] => ([(h + h2)] ++ zip_sum(t, t2)) } }
}
